content: Jesudi yoyout diniyeti gineŋ kamekaaŋ yoguk
Jesu kotigoŋ imeŋgwaŋ gagayeŋ wooŋ Mede Momooŋ yeniyeniŋ tuguk, kaŋ metam feedi wooŋ bopnegiŋ kaŋ muwage foloŋ looŋ ila
yoyout mede foloŋ mede fee yeniŋguk.
Niŋ e indiŋ, “I nadineŋ, me dinina molo niŋ adi nemek yeuli yetibe moŋgola uguk.
Moŋgo wooŋ sayoli kilik kukam unduŋ kukuk. Kulune noli talipmeŋ magiŋ kaŋ bagi hekidi kunatnagiŋ.
Noli kwet kawadenit foloŋ maaŋ kwet wahiŋgoŋ doktiŋa pilap kadogiŋ.
Iŋgoŋ kokoihik fuluŋgoŋ mu fogiŋ doktiŋa mele diweeŋ kawade dafafaŋeune kumuŋ tigiŋ.
Kaŋ noli haŋginep maaneŋ maaŋ labugiŋ iŋgoŋ haŋginepdi hefulaune folooŋ mu tigiŋ.
Noli kwet galikit foloŋ magiŋ adi kedem labuŋa folohik fee duhugiŋ. Tiŋa kwedei niŋ diniŋ folooŋ 30, noli diniŋ 60 eŋ noli diniŋ 100. Unduŋ mintagiŋ.”
U yenindapmaaŋ indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Nebek niŋ adi nadidakalewe kaŋ magi baigoŋ kametnadiŋa nadiwek.”
Dediŋ doktiŋa yoyout gineŋ hogok mede yohautalak yoŋa ninadigiŋ
Jesu nehogok halune, me noli adi mihiŋiye tuwelupdut noŋgoŋ wooŋ ila yoyout mededok ninadi tigiŋ kaŋ indiŋ yeniŋguk,
“Bepaŋ’walaŋ hebeŋ foloŋ Hatihati Kobuli diniŋ mede hebiniŋ hatak u Bepaŋdi agaŋ hanimbihitak. Kaŋ me noli fakaŋkade hatiiŋ adi yoyout mede foloŋ kamekaaŋ yenilat, ala

content.text: ‘Adi kanim yo kaiŋ iŋgoŋ tuwot mu kadakaleiŋ, eŋ nadinim yo nadiiŋ iŋgoŋ tuwot mu nadidakaleiŋ. Tiŋa kadakaniŋhik sigilulum tiyembune Bepaŋdi tumolokuyembaakneŋ.’”

content: Jesudi yoyout diniyeti gineŋ kamekaaŋ yoguk diniŋ mebi
Tiŋa indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Yoyout i mu nadidakaleeŋ yoyout noli dediŋ tiŋa nadidakaleneŋ?
Mebi adi indiŋ. Metam noli adi kiliki talipmeŋ maune bagidi bu nagiŋ unduŋ tiiŋ. Me Mede Momooŋ yoyo tilak adi mede yobu nadiiŋ iŋgoŋ pilap hinek Sadaŋdi buŋa mede momooŋ u yolom moŋgotak.
Metam noli niŋ adi kiliki kwet kawade foloŋ kukuk undihi. Mede nadiŋa nadigalika hinek tiiŋ
iŋgoŋ welehik maaneŋ hinek mu moŋgokiiŋ doktiŋa Mede Momooŋ diniŋ mik-kwadi buune pilap hinek maiŋ.
Metam noli adi kiliki haŋginep gineŋ kukuk undihi. Mede nadiiŋ
iŋgoŋ oŋ, hatihati kwetfoloŋ diniŋ nadibedi wapum hinek tiiŋ. Welehik wapum muneeŋ bomboŋdok yatak wondi Mede Momooŋ nadiiŋ u kelekulu adi hogok hatifit tiiŋ.
Kaŋ noli adi kiliki kwet fofooŋneŋ kukuk undihi. Adi yadi mede nadiŋa boihatiŋa folooŋ fee yehitubu-mintaiŋ, nolidi 30, nolidi 60 eŋ nolidi 100.”
Hauta galiŋa kufula mu titiŋdok
Kotigoŋ tomboyoula indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Hidi, kamaŋ galiŋa kufula mu tiiŋ. Moŋ hinek. Tobo galiŋa foloniŋ miŋgoŋ kameune ila hautalak.
Nemek kabup hebi hatak u hakene nainiŋde miŋgoŋ mintawaak. Nemek tumut gineŋ hatak u hakene nainiŋde fiyataŋakiyekulune miŋgoŋ mintawaak.
Nebek niŋ nadidakalewene kaŋ magi kametnadi baigoŋ tibek.
Mede i nadiiŋ u gitagoŋ hinek nadihinakaneŋ. Hidi metam nolidok tuwolit dediniŋgoŋ yemaneeŋ kaŋ Bepaŋ adi u kaŋ kabe-kalakapmeeŋ wapumgoŋ hamuluwaak.
Biyagoŋ hinek, nebek niŋ adi nemek miŋgiŋ u behatibukaŋ tomboyoulimimbaak, eŋ nebek niŋ adi nemek miŋgiŋ u mu behatibukaŋ lomtubune hogok hatiluwaak.”
Mede Momooŋ mehinek welehik maaneŋ kwanai tilak
Unduŋ yeniŋa kotigoŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ hatihati kobut dediniŋgoŋ u yoyout mede foloŋ indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Me niŋ adi haŋgom kilik kwetfoloŋ kamelak.
Kameeŋ hatibu helebufa debek uune haŋgom kilik adi tawaaŋ labiiŋ.
Unduŋ tubu me i debekti labiiŋ u mu nadiŋa hatilu looŋ folooŋ tiiŋ. Timeŋ boki labusuwaune, mebi mintaaŋ ilune mindaŋ kitili mintaaŋ looŋ folooŋ tiŋa gilakaune nanaŋdok nai tilak kaŋ wooŋ datak.”
Hatihati kobulidok kigili mede
Unduŋ yeniŋa indiŋ yeninadiguk, “Bepaŋ’walaŋ Hatihati Kobuli u dediniŋ yonim? Yoyout maŋgoŋ foloŋ kamekaaŋ yonene dakalewek?”
Unduŋ yoŋa indiŋ yeniŋguk, “Bepaŋ’walaŋ Hatihati Kobuli adi mastat kilik
dabugoŋ.

Kiliki woŋ adi kuyahi-kabe hinek, kiliki noli yetiyam wendok tuwolit moŋ. Iŋgoŋ mindaŋ mastatdi looŋ wapum tiŋa nemenemek noli yetiyam u yalakapme tiŋa yalune bagi heki adi buŋa taŋeniŋ foloŋ uŋgoŋ deipilat tiiŋ.”
Metamdi nadidakaleneŋ yoŋa Jesudi yoyout mede fee hinek yeniŋguk.
Adi mede didimeŋgoŋ be miŋgilaŋgoŋ nemu yeniluguk. Adi yoyout mede foloŋ hogok kameeŋ yeniluguk doktiŋa mihiŋiye adi nehogok hatugukneŋ wooŋ kaune mebi yenindakaleluguk.
Fifiŋgobut dut imedi Jesu’walaŋ medeŋiŋ nadigumuk
Nai wondok foloŋgoŋ mele folune Jesudi mihiŋiye ime fokolok uuŋdok yeniŋguk

kaŋ metam bop wapum u biyabuŋa muwage Jesudi looŋ yali Mede Momooŋ yeniŋgukneŋ uŋgoŋ looŋ noŋgoŋ ugiŋ. Jesu ne agaŋ koom looŋ ikuk doktiŋa mihiŋiye hogok looŋ ilune noŋgoŋ ugiŋ. Muwage noli maaŋ noŋgoŋ ugiŋ
kaŋ fifiŋgobut wapum tiŋa ime giyondaaŋ buŋa muwagehik gineŋ fotokiwe tuguk.

Kaŋ Jesu adi mebi uloloŋ kameeŋ mindaŋ gwaŋ gitagoŋ damo deihakuk. Tubune mihiŋiye adi munta tiŋa wooŋ talamsukuleeŋ niŋgiŋ, “Hinale, indi agaŋ ime gineŋ wopmabutne tam kaŋ du inditok nadibedi mube tiŋa gitagoŋ deihataŋ?”
Unduŋ nimbune Jesudi pilali yali sububa nihep tiŋa ime indiŋ niŋguk, “Ime, du kulemaŋ fohat.” Unduŋ yenimbune fifiŋgobut wabiune ime maaŋ kulemaaŋ fohakuk,
kaŋ Jesudi yeniŋguk, “Munta maŋgoŋde tiiŋ? Hidi nadisukilitihik moŋ be?”
Unduŋ yeniŋguk kaŋ munta kisaŋ tiŋa yogiŋ, “Me i dediniŋ doktiŋa sububa dut imedi medeŋiŋ nadiyamuk.” Unduŋ yo nehi uŋgoŋ kisaŋ yonadigiŋ.
